baseline.conditions: Local boat excursion; safe tide and quiet channel required.

title: Three kilometres can fill a day
daily_life: Lumen Tide crews work Bellwater Narrows as local water, with nesting, craft and rescue responsibilities. A visitor’s three-kilometre distance is not a reason to ignore them.
timing: One day is a local excursion block, not 24 hours of propulsion. Safe tide, quiet movement, transfer and return decisions fill the schedule. No return duration is automatically granted.
handoff: Share the usable passage, observation time and warning state without publishing protected nesting coordinates. Keep an author’s full map separate from an in-world visitor chart.
story_option: A depth correction helps a rescue without proving the visitor needs ownership of the whole chart. Namu can accept useful evidence while maintaining a boundary.
production: Use the 3.3 boat approach, dock boarding link, stairs and upper refuge. Water and the high arch occupy different elevations. Light does not repel bell-eels.
direction: Listed a-to-b planning reference; reverse passage requires a fresh itinerary.
geometry: Regional endpoints and route length inherited; connecting line is not a surveyed track.
